description: This Java class, LoanRepaymentWorkbookPopulator, extends AbstractWorkbookPopulator and is responsible for generating a spreadsheet workbook for loan repayment data. It manages populating sheets with loan details, setting validation rules, defaults, and organizing data related to loans, clients, and offices for bulk import purposes within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class designed to create and populate an Excel workbook for bulk loan repayment import. It sets up sheets, populates loan info, sets validation rules, and organizes data related to loans, clients, and offices.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the workbook with loan repayment data, sets layout, populates sheets, and applies validation rules.

methods.name: setClientIdToClientExternalId
methods.description: Builds a map from client IDs to their external IDs, used for lookup in the Excel sheet.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default formulas and cell styles for the repayment sheet rows.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines data validation rules for cells, such as dropdown lists and date constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges in the workbook for use in data validation formulas, organized by offices and clients.

methods.name: populateLoansTable
methods.description: Fills the loan repayment sheet with loan data, sorted by active status.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures the sheet layout with headers and column widths.
